authorized_baseline.meaning: authorized executable/application content baseline before the G2 authority overlay was committed

implementation_checkout.purpose: authority-overlay checkout used to create the Codex worktree so the G2 record, validators and context manifest are present locally
implementation_checkout.executable_content_equivalence: The diff from authorized_baseline.main_sha to this commit is limited to G2 governance, validation and status/documentation surfaces; no application/workspace/package/dependency implementation surface changed.

implementer.worktree: dedicated writable Codex worktree created from implementation_checkout.commit_sha

review.review_worktree: separate detached/read-only Cursor worktree at exact candidate SHA

scope_in: remove obsolete workspace and lockfile references to @mudac/judging-operations
rewrite dependency-cruiser rules to the accepted five-owner topology
prove no active executable package, importer, dependency rule, source import, build configuration, or current implementation authority treats Judging Operations as an independent semantic owner
scope_out: historical/superseded documentation cleanup unless required to distinguish history from current executable authority
required_verification: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, except an authorized deterministic lock refresh required solely by removal of the obsolete workspace package
explicit executable-surface residual-reference search for @mudac/judging-operations and packages/modules/judging-operations
fresh-session Cursor adversarial conformance review PASS
circuit_breakers: work requires a package outside IMP-001
another active writer owns a serialized surface
production access, production data, or production credentials become relevant
repair would require weakening tests, criteria, or repository protection
base_drift_rule: Executable authorization remains anchored to authorized_baseline.main_sha/tree. The governance-only G2 authority overlay identified by implementation_checkout may be used as the implementation worktree base because its diff from the executable baseline contains no application/workspace/package/dependency implementation changes. Any other protected-main movement before the implementation worktree is created requires stop-and-rebind or explicit reauthorization. After worktree creation, later main movement is handled by protected-PR integration and compatibility review rather than silently changing the authorized base.
